target_customer: Global B2B sales, marketing and support teams, plus companies holding multilingual meetings and webinars
problem: Technical sales and customer conversations across languages need interpreters who know industry vocabulary, which is costly and hard to book; generic machine translation fumbles jargon.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for real-time AI interpretation

founders.name: Yong Hee Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page lists the title Founder/COO but the bio says co-founder and CEO. He met his co-founder in 2015 through a KAIST student club that ran an international conference; degrees not stated.

founders.name: Gunwoo Kim
founders.background_notes: YC page gives first name only; full name and CTO title come from a press profile search result. KAIST link only via the student club.

competitors.name: Microsoft Teams Interpreter agent
competitors.what: Speech to speech real-time interpretation in Teams meetings
competitors.traction_then: announced November 2024, public preview early 2025, requires Copilot license

technical_complexity.rationale: Low latency speech translation with live injection of company glossaries and documents is hard to tune, but it builds on available speech and language models.

defensibility.rationale: Platform vendors and model providers ship interpretation features; differentiation rests on custom terminology handling and enterprise relationships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft launched an Interpreter agent in Teams in 2025 and Zoom and Google offer translation features; no acquisition of Cuckoo found.

market_need_then: Cross-border sales and distributed teams needed live interpretation, and human interpreters are expensive; the company cites customers such as Snowflake and PagerDuty on its site.

identity.logo: A directory listing shows a plain letter C

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch reported 405 upvotes and a top 4 daily rank in March 2025 per a search summary.

brand_strength.rationale: Some launch attention but no brand coverage found and the name is shared with other firms such as a UK broadband provider and a bird.

outcome_analysis: Cuckoo Labs is active with a two person team in Seoul. It joined YC in Winter 2025, launched publicly in March 2025, signed technical software customers and raised a 1.8M dollar seed in November 2025. The main risk is that Microsoft, Zoom and Google bundle interpretation, so its edge is terminology customization.
notes: Seed amount of 1.8M USD is reported by Asiae, Wowtale (page blocked on fetch, seen in search results), Venture Square and TheSaaSNews. VC Backed lists 1.7M and ZeroG Talent 2.2M across two rounds; an earlier round was not confirmed. Founder education and employers not found beyond the KAIST club link. Competitor traction beyond Microsoft not verified.
